name: Handle Ambiguous Notebook Request
query: Update my robotics notebook with the latest notes
context: The user has access to multiple projects and several notebooks with similar names. The projects include 'AI Research' and 'Robotics Project'. Matching notebook items include 'Robotics Notes.md', 'Robotics Research.md', and 'Humanoid Robotics.md'. The phrase 'latest notes' does not identify a specific notebook, and no project_id or item_id is provided. The requested update content is also not included in the current request.
expected_behavior: Recognizes that the requested target notebook is ambiguous
Does not arbitrarily select a project
Does not arbitrarily select one of the matching notebooks
Uses discovery tools only if necessary to narrow the candidates
Uses get_projects when project context is required
Uses get_notebook with search when notebook discovery is required
Does not call update_notebook while the target remains ambiguous
Asks the user which project and notebook they mean
Recognizes that the requested update content is missing
Asks for the actual notes or content to add
Does not call create_notebook or delete_notebook
success_criteria: The model identifies both target ambiguity and missing update content
The clarification request is specific enough for the user to answer
The model does not guess based on notebook names
The model does not claim that an update was performed
The model remains within the current notebook-management MCP contract
